description: Tags are small, exos-CUSTOM status/labelling glyphs. There are three independent families: `tag-provider` (a two-piece creator badge for provider/avatar slots), `tag-status` (an inline icon + label showing a status), and `tag-order` (a compact icon + short label, e.g. an order/line tag). All three share the `tag-{color}` color modifier, generated by their respective @each builder mixins over the $theme-and-diagram-colors map (theme colors + diagram colors, incl. tealGreen). A separate `status-pill` renders a colored text pill from the $theme-labels map.

always: Pick exactly one family base class: tag-provider, tag-status, tag-order, or status-pill.
Add the color via a single `tag-{color}` modifier alongside the family base class (provider/status/order families).
tag-status and tag-order expect a leading icon-* glyph element; the builder colors that glyph.
never: Do not mix two family base classes on one element.
Do not invent a `tag-` color that is not in the theme/diagram color set.

a11y: Decorative glyphs inside a tag should be marked aria-hidden="true"; convey the status through visible text or an aria-label.
If a tag communicates status by color alone, include a text label so the meaning is not color-dependent.

family.description: Which tag construct to render. Each is a literal base class.

provider.note: Two-piece creator badge; contains a `tag-creator` glyph element.

order.note: Compact icon + short label, e.g. an order/line tag.

pill.note: Text status pill colored from the $theme-labels map; pair with a tag-{label} modifier.

color.description: Color modifier for the provider/status/order families. Generated by tag-provider-builder / tag-status-builder / tag-order-builder over the $theme-and-diagram-colors map (theme + diagram colors).

themed.note: Colors the glyph (status/order) or creator badge (provider). Generated, never a literal selector.

label.description: Color modifier for the status-pill family only. Generated by label-status-builder over the $theme-labels map (success/primary/danger/neutral/warning). Only the colors that exist in tokens.json are listed below; `neutral` is generated in source but excluded because it is not a known token color.

themed.note: Sets the pill's text + background from $theme-labels. `tag-neutral` also exists in source but is omitted (not a token color).

root.note: Shown for the tag-status family; swap the base class for the chosen family + add a tag-{color} modifier.

children.note: A leading icon-* glyph; the family builder colors it. Followed by the status text.
